With Americans heading to the polls, Donald Trump had 25 minutes to talk about the midterms.
Instead, he spent much of his speech discussing algae, pipes and renovations to the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool.
The unusual focus has drawn attention away from his election pitch.
